meta.title: Thanos Automa · play Splendor Marvel solo
meta.description: A free phone companion for playing Splendor Marvel solo against the fan-made Thanos automa. It runs his deck, his tokens and his race to the Infinity Gauntlet, while your table holds the game.
meta.ogDescription: Your table holds the game. This app runs Thanos: his deck, his tokens, his race to the Gauntlet.

hero.caption: Splendor Marvel · solo
hero.lead: Play Splendor Marvel solo against the fan-made Thanos automa. Your table holds the game. This phone app runs Thanos: his deck, his tokens and his race to the Infinity Gauntlet.

strip.title: A companion, not a digital game

table.title: On your table
table.text: You play your turns as usual, with the real game.

app.title: In the app
app.text: Thanos plays his turns through your phone.

steps.alt: Thanos makes his move: the automa card back, tap to reveal
steps.title: Flip his card
steps.text: Thanos always goes first. The app shuffles his deck for each phase and reads the right section of the card.

steps.alt: Thanos recruits: the market map, the tokens he returns, and which stone is on the card
steps.title: Do what he says
steps.text: Which tokens he takes, which card he recruits, the colour substitution, and which tokens go back first: you just move them on the table.

steps.alt: At the table: a checklist of his move, then your move
steps.title: Play your turn
steps.text: Tick off the table checklist, play as usual, and log the card you recruited: its level, colour, points and Avengers tags.

steps.alt: You win: you completed the Infinity Gauntlet
steps.title: Race to the Gauntlet
steps.text: At the end of every round the app checks both sides for the Infinity Gauntlet, with the official tiebreakers. Complete it within 30 rounds, or it’s a SNAP.

items.title: Runs his deck
items.text: Shuffles each phase, reads green, yellow, then red, and keeps the 30-round clock.

items.title: Tells you exactly what he does
items.text: Tokens in printed order, the slot he recruits, colour substitution and the oldest tokens back first.

items.title: Keeps his bookkeeping
items.text: His token piles, cards, points, the Avengers tile and the Time stone.

items.title: Checks the Gauntlet
items.text: Every round, for both sides, with the official tiebreakers and the automa’s rules for ties.

items.title: Undo anything
items.text: Every step can be undone, and the game is saved after every tap.

items.title: Made for the table
items.text: Installs to your home screen, works offline and keeps the screen awake during a game.

items.title: Rules where you need them
items.text: Tap the “i” next to a step to read the rule it follows, right at the table.

items.title: Rulings for the gaps
items.text: Where the automa PDF is silent, the defaults follow the BoardGameGeek clarifications, and you can change them.

items.alt: New game setup: table checklist and difficulty
items.label: Set up and pick a difficulty

items.alt: Thanos takes tokens; tap a token if its pile is empty
items.label: He takes tokens

items.alt: Colour substitution: he already has that colour
items.label: Colour substitution

items.alt: Log your card: level, bonus colour, points and Avengers tags
items.label: Log your card

items.alt: Thanos’s hoard: token piles, return order and his cards
items.label: His hoard

items.alt: The game log, newest round first
items.label: The game log

items.alt: SNAP: round 30 ended without your Infinity Gauntlet
items.label: Or… SNAP.

languages.caption: Five languages
languages.title: Speaks your language
languages.text: It starts in your phone’s language, and you can switch any time. Every text, including the rules and Thanos’s lines, is translated. So is this page.

get.caption: You need the box
get.title: Get the game
get.text: The app only runs Thanos. You play with the physical Splendor Marvel, designed by Marc André and published by Space Cowboys.

store.name: Asmodee store locator
store.more: Find a shop near you that sells it

run.caption: Run it yourself
run.title: Host your own copy
run.text: It’s a static web app with no server code, accounts or tracking. Build the Docker image, or the static files, and serve them over HTTPS so phones can install it.
run.serve: # serve the dist/ folder over HTTPS
